QuestionStmt.S: What is the volume occupied by 0.5 mol of $CO_2$ at STP?

Solution.S:
At Standard Temperature and Pressure (STP), 1 mole of any ideal gas occupies 22.4 dm³.

Given:
Number of moles, n = 0.5 mol

To find:
Volume occupied by 0.5 mol of CO₂ at STP.

Step 1:
Volume occupied by 1 mol at STP = 22.4 dm³

Step 2:
Volume occupied by 0.5 mol:
$$V_{\text{CO}_2} = 0.5 \times 22.4 \, \text{dm}^3 = 11.2 \, \text{dm}^3$$

So, the correct answer is Option B: 11.2 dm³.
